Document: # Rule 3.7 Competence is expected within command and security. - Neither command nor security should be grossly incompetent in their responsibilities. Both roles are held to a higher standard than other jobs and should generally be considered dependable. Command should be role-models for their departments. - You should not take direct, unchallengeable orders from people other than your job superiors. - You should not knowingly break the law as either command or security, unless permission is given by an admin beforehand. - Command staff should be familiar with Standard Operating Procedure and follow it to the best of their abilities. Security should understand both Standard Operating Procedure and Space-Law; security members should follow and enforce both Space-Law and SOP to the best of their ability. Failure to do so may result in a role ban. - Generally speaking, a ban in command will also result in a ban from security for the same duration, and vise versa. - Currently, we use Wizard's Den Space-Law and SOP; you can find these at https://wiki.spacestation14.io/wiki.
